mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user(username, display_name, password_hash, token_version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES(#{username}, #{displayName}, #{passwordHash}, 1, datetime('now'), datetime('now'))
mapper.update: UPDATE app_user SET last_login_at = datetime('now'), updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE app_user SET display_name = #{displayName}, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE app_user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, token_version = token_version + 1, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE app_user SET token_version = token_version + 1, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE app_user SET failed_attempts = 0, locked_until = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE app_user SET failed_attempts = COALESCE(failed_attempts, 0) + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE app_user SET failed_attempts = 0, locked_until = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE app_user SET email = #{email}, verification_token = #{verificationToken}, email_verified = 0, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE app_user SET email_verified = 1, verification_token = NULL, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = #{id}
